summary: Backend only. Updated backend/tests/test_iter346_mass_copy_emails.py to match the new design, where the copy goes in a SEPARATE send, once, with template variables blanked. 18/18 pass with -p no:xdist. There are two kinds of tests. HTTP tests check email_logs. Integrators: [2 main, 2 copy]. Bank single_bcc: [3, 1]. per_contact: [0,0,0,2]. per_bank: main batches {1,2} plus copy 1. In the copy, the subject and html_preview have no '{' and no bank or contact name. A copy address that matches a recipient (case-insensitive) is excluded, and no extra send happens. Without copy_emails, or with whitespace only, there is no extra send. Unit tests call _mass_dispatch with send_email, db, sender and signature mocked. They check the exact BCC lists: batches have no copies, and the copy goes to=[sender] with bcc=deduped copies minus recipients. The {x} and {{x}} variables are removed, while fecha_sistema and Firma are rendered. '<style>p {margin:0} .a{color:red}</style>' is unchanged, and normalize_email_html does not alter it either. If the copy send fails, it is caught and the main sends are not affected.

minor.issue: Blanking leaves extra spaces, e.g. the copy subject 'TEST346 x Hola ' / 'Aviso ' (trailing or double space). Consider collapsing whitespace in the subject after _blank_template_vars.
_TPL_VAR_RE will also strip legitimate literal tokens like '{token}' in the body text of the copy. Acceptable but undocumented.
A failed copy send is added to batch_errors but does not change result.status, which is computed only from the main batches. The UI may show full success even though the copy failed.

action_items: Optional: collapse whitespace in the blanked copy subject.
Optional: show the copy-send failure in status/message.
